title: Comali
desc: A long coma leaves Ravi disorientated in an unrecognisable world. However, he sets out on a journey to reclaim his past and adapt to a new reality.

title: Vinnaithaandi Varuvaayaa
desc: A Hindu assistant director, Karthik, falls in love with Jessie, a Christian from a traditional family. Things change when Karthik becomes busy during a forty-day shoot in Goa.

title: Yashoda
desc: Surrogate mother Yashodha is advised to follow a few guidelines to keep herself and her baby healthy and safe. However, something happens at the surrogate centre that puts both of them at risk.

title: Kochi Rajavu
desc: Tragedy strikes when Unni accidentally kills his lover's cousin, resulting in his imprisonment.

title: Gatta Kusthi
desc: Veera has a preconceived set of criteria for what he wants in a bride. However, he ends up unexpectedly marrying a woman who is the complete opposite of his expectations.
